description: This file defines the PendingSaveRequests class which manages pending save requests for titles and content in the Notesnook project, including localStorage operations and posting requests.

classes.name: PendingSaveRequests
classes.description: Class managing pending save requests, including setting, retrieving, removing, and posting pending titles and contents.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Adds a new pending title to localStorage.

methods.name: getPendingTitles
methods.description: Retrieves all pending titles from localStorage.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Adds a new pending content to localStorage.

methods.name: getPendingContent
methods.description: Retrieves all pending contents from localStorage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets an item from localStorage by key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from localStorage by key.

methods.name: getPendingTitleIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all pending titles.

methods.name: getPendingContentIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all pending contents.

methods.name: removePendingTitlesById
methods.description: Removes pending titles by their IDs.

methods.name: removePendingContentsById
methods.description: Removes pending contents by their IDs.

methods.name: postPendingRequests
methods.description: Posts all pending titles and contents, marking them as pending changes.
